mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units and payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 144000 thousand signal synchronized demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1200 AND PAYEMS < 144000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars indicate robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 144000 thousand signal labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 AND PAYEMS < 144000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.
